name: ${mod_name}
description: Multicore optimization for Minecraft. Spreads chunk generation across every CPU core (dedicated worldgen pool, parallel surface and carver stages, parallel pre-generation) and ships with the tools to measure it: live dashboard, stage profiler, A/B benchmark and vanilla parity fingerprint. Press K or type /polycore.
contributors: Parallel stages follow the thread-safety analysis of Paper/Moonrise (Spottedleaf). Pre-generation inspired by NeoForge's /neoforge generate and fabric-chunkpregenerator.
